{"segment_text":"Defending the Human Rights of Palestinian Children and Families Living Under Israeli Military Occupation Act
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.
<enum>2.</enum>
<header>Findings</header>
<text display-inline="no-display-inline">Congress finds the following:</text>
<paragraph id="H0C59BD49CBA149FCA34B97459E49B5C1">
<enum>(1)</enum>
<text>Approximately 3,100,000 Palestinians live in the West Bank, of which around 42 percent are children under the age of 18 who have lived their entire lives under Israeli military control.</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA9D98247338B42E5AC6E8FA5F9AAD6C4">
<enum>(2)</enum>
<text>In the Israeli-occupied West Bank, there are two separate and unequal legal systems, with Israeli military law imposed on Palestinians and Israeli civilian law applied to Israeli settlers.</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H9F9DDEC41A1143AC86C53CBA4C83DA44">
House
<enum>(3)</enum>
<text>Children are entitled to special protections and due process rights under international human rights law and international humanitarian law.</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H2CD2311BDED445418FBF31445711DEB0">
<enum>(4)</enum>
<text>Israel has ratified the Convention on the Rights of the Child, which states—</text><subparagraph id="H18D6211578684C30A71EE27D5DCED68E">
<enum>(A)</enum>
<text>in article 37(a), that <quote>no child shall be subject to torture or other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment</quote>;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H8EF5491C70244533B27968CCC90E7763">
<enum>(B)</enum>
<text>in article 37(b), that the arrest, detention or imprisonment of a child <quote>shall be used only as a measure of last resort and for the shortest appropriate period of time</quote>;</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="H12D80A55347A4907A8540F3C76B7864C">
<enum>(C)</enum>

<text>in article 37(c), that <quote>every child deprived of liberty shall be treated with humanity and respect for the inherent dignity of the human person, and in a manner which takes into account the needs of persons of his or her age</quote>; and</text></subparagraph><subparagraph id="HC26DDB324BF943A9B497ED026066F4BD">
<enum>(D)</enum>
<text>in article 37(d), that <quote>[e]very child deprived of his or her liberty shall have the right to prompt access to legal and other appropriate assistance, as well as the right to challenge the legality of the deprivation of his or her liberty before a court or other competent, independent and impartial authority, and to a prompt decision on any such action</quote>.</text></subparagraph></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HE6DA826C286A4268A5BA9E06DBA277D9">
<enum>(5)</enum>
<text>The Government of Israel and its military detains around 500 to 700 Palestinian children between the ages of 12 and 17 each year and prosecutes them before a military court system that lacks basic and fundamental guarantees of due process in violation of international standards.</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="H754B92DC4AA842F0914C8B9601A51CAC">
<enum>(6)</enum>
<text>Israeli security forces detain children under the age of 12 for interrogation for extended periods of time even though the prosecution of children under 12 is prohibited by Israeli military law.</text></paragraph>
<paragraph id="HA186BDDA9BF942438B11FC258C30BFA6">
<legis-body id="HCCA7D54B514E45E8BB14C7DAD269C991" style="OLC">
<enum>(7)</enum>
<section id="H8B40ECF34DF94E2984704BAF27023C7C" section-type="section-one">
<enum>1.</enum>
<header>Short title</header>
<text display-inline="no-display-inline">This Act may be cited as the <quote><short-title>Defending the Human Rights of Palestinian Children and Families Living Under Israeli Military Occupation Act</short-title></quote>.</text></section>
